name: CAT
pattern: 3 sections: VARC, DILR, QA; 40 minutes per section
marking_scheme: +3 per correct answer; -1 per wrong MCQ; no negative marking on non-MCQ
eligibility: Bachelor's degree with at least 50% (45% SC/ST); final-year students may apply; no age limit

name: XAT
pattern: Verbal Ability and Logical Reasoning, Decision Making, Quantitative Aptitude and Data Interpretation, General Knowledge; no sectional time limits
marking_scheme: Skip limit before penalty stated as both 8 and 12 on the official page; confirm in bulletin
eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from recognized university

name: SNAP
pattern: General English, Analytical and Logical Reasoning, Quantitative/Data Interpretation/Data Sufficiency, Ethics/Morality/Values; four options per question
attempts_rule: Up to 3 attempts; higher score used for final percentile
eligibility: Graduates with at least 50% (45% SC/ST); final-year candidates may apply if the programme allows

name: NMAT
attempts_rule: Up to 3 attempts in a testing cycle; only first attempt considered for NMIMS Mumbai admissions
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50%; final-year students can apply; no work experience or age limit

name: CMAT
pattern: Quantitative Techniques, Logical Reasoning, Language Comprehension, General Awareness, Innovation & Entrepreneurship
eligibility: Final-year graduation students eligible per official notification

name: GMAT Focus Edition
pattern: Quantitative Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning, Data Insights; sections in any order; one optional 10-minute break
score_scale: Total 205 to 805 in steps of 10 (all end in 5); sections 60 to 90; scores valid 5 years
